Title: Compact Bass
Description: These bass speakers extend the frequency range of compact systems, making them suitable for small to medium-sized venues and installations where high-quality bass is essential but space is constrained.

Title: Compact
Description: The Compact range brings Funktion-One's renowned sound quality to smaller formats. These speakers are versatile, used in everything from desktop monitoring to small live shows and in-fill for larger systems.

Title: Evolution
Description: This series represents the pinnacle of point-source loudspeaker performance. It features high output, controlled directivity, and is designed for versatility across a wide range of live event applications.

Title: Public Address
Description: These horn-loaded, high-efficiency speakers are optimized for speech clarity and intelligibility. They combine lightweight design with durability, making them ideal for public speaking events and large gatherings where vocal clarity is crucial.

Title: Vero
Description: This is a large-format vertical array system designed for unparalleled audio performance and efficient rigging. It's ideal for large venues and outdoor events, offering exceptional sound quality and easy setup.

Title: Resolution
Description: The Resolution series is a point-source system appreciated for its performance across various applications, from DJ monitoring to large-scale concerts. It offers high output, controlled directivity, and exceptional intelligibility.

Title: Bass Reflex
Description: These speakers provide a powerful bass 'hit' at close range with a smaller footprint. They are perfect for applications where space is limited but high-quality bass is still required.

Title: Dance Stack
Description: Known for its iconic design, the Dance Stack series delivers powerful, transparent, and pure sound. It's a popular choice for nightclubs and dance events, providing a visually and sonically impressive experience.

Title: Monitor
Description: Funktion-One's monitor range provides high-quality stage sound with no need for EQ, ensuring that performers hear the same full-bodied sound as the audience. These monitors are designed for clarity and power, essential for live performances.

Title: Vero VX
Description: A medium-format vertical array system, the Vero VX provides similar audio quality to the larger Vero system but in a more compact footprint. It includes high-efficiency drivers and advanced rigging options, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor events where space is a consideration.

Title: Horn Loaded Bass
Description: Known for smooth output, extended depth, and transient response, these bass speakers are ideal for delivering powerful, high-quality low frequencies. They are suitable for both close-range and long-distance bass projection.
